verdict.rationale: The only product-native evidence of event-triggered automation is the split feature, which divides inbound funds across multiple parties automatically when they arrive. That is a predefined rule type, not a general rules engine. Webhook events and scheduled transfers are developer building blocks or time-based actions, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-definable rule/trigger-action engine, coverage of event types beyond inbound funds, documentation of how rules are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
